sources.title: Empowering few-shot learning: a multimodal optimization framework
sources.snippet: This work proposes the generic multimodal optimization-based few-shot learning framework (GoFSL). The framework leverages few-shot learning to learn from a few data, multimodal learning to learn a rich representation of image and text data, and meta-learning to help the model generalization.

sources.title: PDF Empowering few-shot learning: a multimodal optimization framework
sources.snippet: This open problem leads to research in multimodal few-shot learning (FSL), where the model acquires new con-cepts from a few data composed of two or more modalities. In the literature, several studies have investigated this problem. Transformer-based multimodal FSL learns an optimized data alignment from different modalities [7, 8].

sources.title: Multimodal Few-Shot Learning with Frozen Language Models
sources.snippet: When trained at sufficient scale, auto-regressive language models exhibit the notable ability to learn a new language task after being prompted with just a few examples. Here, we present a simple, yet effective, approach for transferring this few-shot learning ability to a multimodal setting (vision and language).
